mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, we have clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 79 degrees, though it feels a bit warmer at 87.
The Public Works Department wants to ensure you stay updated on street maintenance, refuse, and utility services, so be sure to subscribe to the city newsletter for all the latest notices.
We have plenty to look forward to, including Yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by trivia tomorrow at Hop Haus Brewing Company and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Regarding our weekly report, on July 31, a driver was arrested for an O W I after being spotted driving without taillights and on a flat tire.
Today's flavor at the Verona location is the indulgent Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store is open until 10 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to satisfy your sweet tooth.
